subject: P95 Drift: m11-proto EU peak latency surge — request rollback and routing override
messages:
From: Paul Santos <paul.santos@finqorp.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Jul 2027 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: m11-proto EU: P95 spike affecting FinQorp API

Tessa / Marcus —

We started seeing a sustained P95 increase on the m11-proto variant serving our EU traffic around 08:20 UTC this morning. P50 is stable (~180ms) but P95 jumped from ~240ms to ~1.4s for the last 90 minutes. This is impacting our realtime scoring endpoint (finqorp.com/api/score) — customers are reporting timeouts and increased retries.

Attached: p95_grafana_snapshot_20270718.png (screenshot), p95_extract_20270718.csv (raw bucketed p95 values)

Immediate ask: can Redwood approve a temporary, timeboxed rollback to m11-proto@v1.2 for the EU region + a routing override to send FinQorp EU production traffic to us-east (US) for a 2-hour window while we stabilize?

We need a decision in the next 30–45 minutes. If rollback is allowed, please confirm the window and canary percentage so we can update our incident playbook and customer comms.

Thanks,
Paul
Director, Platform Engineering — FinQorp

---
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Paul Santos <paul.santos@finqorp.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Jul 2027 16:28:12 +0000
Subject: Re: m11-proto EU: P95 spike affecting FinQorp API

Thanks Paul — filing this into our queue and looping in ops/leadership.

Summary of what we see from infra: P95 jump correlates with a change in tokenization behavior for a small % of requests that changed sequence-length distribution (likely a prep-step change at FinQorp), which amplified the tail for the current quantization path. Model binary itself was unchanged since last rollout.

Proposed immediate mitigation (requires approval):
- Timeboxed rollback to m11-proto@v1.2 in EU for 2 hours (target start within 30m)
- Canary plan: start at 10% traffic for 10 minutes, then ramp to 50% for 20 minutes if P95 stabilizes, then full rollback if safe
- Routing override option: divert FinQorp EU traffic to us-east node pool for the same time window if cross-region latency is acceptable to them

Risks: cache warming and increased tokens/sec cost during rollback; possible brief error spike during canary. See attached rollback-playbook-v2.md for runbook and rollback steps.

Can Marcus or Jordan confirm authority to proceed and any constraint on the canary? Marcus — can you also include estimated cost delta for the window?

Tessa Morgan
Sr. Manager, Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference

---
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Paul Santos <paul.santos@finqorp.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Jul 2027 17:03:40 +0000
Subject: Re: m11-proto EU: P95 spike affecting FinQorp API

Agree with Tessa's mitigation path. Approval notes below:

- Authorization: I approve a timeboxed rollback to m11-proto@v1.2 in EU with the proposed canary (10% -> 50% -> full) provided infra monitors these metrics in the first 10 minutes and we have an abort threshold (P95 > 1s for the canary group).
- Customer routing override to us-east: approve for a 2-hour window only if FinQorp confirms SLO tolerance for cross-region migration. Please get their signoff before executing routing change.
- Cost estimate: ballpark +12–18% token cost for the window due to cache miss heat; budget owner note required for anything beyond 2 hours.

I've opened JIRA: JIRA-INF-4321 to track the rollback and postmortem. Grafana link (internal): https://grafana.redwood-inference.com/d/abcd1234/m11-proto-eu?from=162

Marcus Lin
Director, Inference Ops
Redwood Inference

---
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Paul Santos <paul.santos@finqorp.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Jul 2027 21:55:00 +0000
Subject: Re: m11-proto EU: P95 spike affecting FinQorp API

Approved.

Execute the rollback with the canary steps Marcus outlined. Abort if any canary bucket exceeds P95 of 1s or error rate increases by >0.5% relative to baseline. Notify FinQorp of the timing and keep status updates every 15 minutes until we hit steady state.

Triage owners: Evelyn (monitoring + rollback execution), Soojin (network routing override), Tessa (customer comms + runbook). Marcus will own cost notices and the postmortem.

Jordan Blake
VP, Product Operations — Redwood Inference
